description: This file defines a React functional component called TwoFactorSwitch that manages the display and toggle control for two-factor authentication (2FA) settings within a user security preferences interface. It handles different states such as not logged in, loading, and toggling 2FA, utilizing external UI components and observable state management.

methods.name: TwoFactorSwitch
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a toggle switch for enabling/disabling 2FA, showing loader when fetching, or nothing if not logged in.
